project.title: Screen Sidekick
project.tagline: A Rust + GPUI screenshot utility for capture, preview, and future annotation workflows.

summary.short: Screen Sidekick is a macOS-first Rust + GPUI screenshot utility with portable core boundaries for capture, history, annotation, and future Windows support.
summary.long: The current M0 milestone includes a three-crate workspace, fullscreen capture through xcap, native-resolution RGBA preservation, quick-save PNG output, a transparent GPUI floating preview, sidecar v1 foundations, and isolated platform dependencies.
